export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug aries-medtek-private-limited): "2026-01-02 | ARIES MEDTEK PRIVATE LIMITED TO THE ORDER OF | I.V. CANNULA WITH INJECTION VALVE WITH WINGS SIZE: 20G X 32MM- | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | MOSCOW, RUSSIA | 90183930 | 8424027". Page header states "Total Shipments 36 Records detected", "Trading Partners 1", "Ports 2", "Latest Cargo 2026-01-02". Rows actually visible in the free view: 4 shipment lines (all dated 2026-01-02, all B/L 8424027, all destination MOSCOW, RUSSIA, all HS 90183930). Port table shows DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4 = 8 and MOSCOW = 8, i.e. the counter (36) exceeds the rows actually seen (4) — the free view is truncated, so 36 is the platform's claim, not a verified count.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: a dated customs record with B/L number, destination (Moscow, Russia), port lane (Delhi Air Cargo ACC) and HS code 90183930 exists. HS correction: declared HS 901839 is the 6-digit heading; the actual shipment code is 90183930 (I.V. cannula with injection valve with wings) — consistent with the heading, so no HS mismatch. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is wrong: the goods are disposable medical devices (IV cannulas), i.e. medical consumables — the industry label should be corrected, but per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be checked: DuckDuckGo/searx backend was down (connection refused) and Bing returned only generic 'Aries' astrology/brokerage results for both quoted-name queries; no company website, GST or tender page was retrieved. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as 'none found' — absence was not established. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the free view; not invented). No CIN/PAN found in retrieved sources.
